statement: Pinned hid-nintendo handles USB-specific output 0x80 command/status exchanges, distinguishing handshake 0x02, baudrate 0x03 and timeout management from ordinary rumble/subcommand output; it expects matching 0x81 acknowledgements.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Consumer source-only startup. USB command expectations are not established for Bluetooth or independent retail timing.
